comments.LineComment: | `Data.String.*` UTF-8 codec is written over. A `Char` is a Unicode **code point** on this
| backend (ADR 0030 — not a UTF-16 code unit), represented as an `i32`, so both directions are
| the **identity** on that `i32`; on wasm they resolve to the `CharCodeId` intrinsic (no-op).
| Per ADR 0026, `Wasm.*` is first-order only — no HOFs, no `Prelude`. All types are `Prim`
| The accompanying `Wasm/Char.js` provides them for stock `purs` / `purs-backend-es` (there a
| `Char` is a JS UTF-16 unit, so the JS impls use `charCodeAt` / `fromCharCode`).
